defensiveAbilities.name: Meltdown
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The irradiated undead plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by energy damage of any kind

Effect The energy acts as a catalyst for a nuclear reaction, causing the plant to explode and dealing 5d6 Poison Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:emanation with a Basic DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Radioactive Remains
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn inside the aura is exposed to severe radiation.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Strafing Snap
offensiveAbilities.description: The irradiated undead flyer Strides twice up to its Speed in a straight line, making a single wing slash Strike against all creatures whose spaces it flies adjacent to. All creatures damaged by the Strafing Snap are considered to be within the flyer's aura at the start of their next turn. The flyer can't use Strafing Snap again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wing Spasm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The irradiated undead flyer channels energy into its wings, forcing all creatures in a 10ft Type:emanation to attempt a DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature takes 1d8 Void Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d8 Void Damage damage and is pushed back 5 feet.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8 Void Damage damage and is pushed back 10 feet.
